title: Coconut Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic coconut-infused biryani recipe. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they're tender.
Add the biryani masala and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the jain basmati rice and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
